subtitle: Devangana Desai and the many meanings of Khajuraho’s stone

panels.shot: wide, low-angle view of Khajuraho temples at dusk with Devangana Desai small in foreground silhouette, notebook in hand
panels.action: Devangana Desai stands before the soaring shikharas of a Khajuraho temple at sunset, wind brushing her sari as countless carved figures glow in the golden light.

dialogue.text: For centuries, Khajuraho was blamed, praised, simplified. Then Devangana Desai stood before the stone and asked: what if the walls are saying something far more intricate than lust?

i18n.hi: सदियों तक खजुराहो को कभी दोष मिला, कभी प्रशंसा, अक्सर सरलीकरण। फिर देवांगना देसाई ने पत्थर के सामने खड़े होकर पूछा: क्या दीवारें वासना से कहीं ज़्यादा पेचीदा बात कह रही हैं?

panels.shot: slow push-in from aerial view of the Chandela temple group down to Devangana tracing carvings with her eyes
panels.action: A bird’s-eye view of clustered temples among trees shifts down to Devangana Desai studying a frieze, her fingers hovering a respectful inch from the stone couples and gods.

dialogue.text: Khajuraho, once a Chandela capital in the 10th to 12th centuries, holds temples where gods, dancers, ascetics and lovers share one crowded stone sky. Yet one kind of figure stole all the attention.

i18n.hi: दसवीं से बारहवीं सदी की चंदेल राजधानी रहा खजुराहो, जहाँ देवता, नर्तक, तपस्वी और प्रेमी एक ही पत्थर के आसमान में भीड़ हैं। फिर भी एक तरह की आकृतियाँ सारी नज़रें खींच ले गईं।

panels.shot: tight lateral tracking along outer wall showing erotic couple amid many non-erotic figures
panels.action: A close lateral view of an outer wall band reveals a sequence of musicians, warriors, women at toilette, and between them, one sculpted erotic couple in intimate embrace.

dialogue.text: Modern visitors’ eyes jump to the erotic maithuna panels. But these are a fraction of the stone—less than a tenth—set mostly on outer walls, surrounded by deities, court life and celestial nymphs.

i18n.hi: आज के दर्शक सीधा नज़रें मिलाते हैं कामुक मैथुन चित्रों से। पर वे पत्थर का ज़रा हिस्सा हैं—दसवें भाग से भी कम—ज़्यादातर बाहरी दीवारों पर, चारों तरफ देवता, दरबार और अप्सराएँ।

panels.shot: medium shot of Devangana in an archive room, books and photographs spread out, lamplight focused on a Khajuraho photograph
panels.action: In a quiet study lined with shelves, Devangana Desai leans over black-and-white photographs of Khajuraho sculptures, notes and reference books open around her under a focused lamp.

dialogue.text: By the 1970s, scholars and guides had filled the silence with easy answers: tantric orgies, decadence, even ‘stone sex-manuals’. Devangana Desai turned instead to the evidence.

i18n.hi: सत्तर के दशक तक विद्वान और गाइड आसान जवाब दे चुके थे: तांत्रिक रासलीला, पतन, यहाँ तक कि ‘पत्थर का कामसूत्र’। देवांगना देसाई ने उलटे सबूतों की ओर देखा।

panels.shot: over-the-shoulder close-up of her reading an inscription rubbing or printed facsimile
panels.action: Over her shoulder, a rubbing of a temple inscription lies beside her notebook as she underlines lines with a pencil, her brow furrowed in concentration.

dialogue.text: She read the Khajuraho inscriptions, including those of the Vishvanatha temple. They speak of Shaiva, Vaishnava and Jain devotions, of kings and merits, not of a declared tantric sex cult.

i18n.hi: उन्होंने खजुराहो के शिलालेख पढ़े, जिनमें विश्वनाथ मंदिर के लेख भी थे। वे शिव, विष्णु और जैन भक्ति की, राजाओं और पुण्य की बातें करते हैं, किसी खुले तांत्रिक काम–पंथ की नहीं।

panels.shot: montage-style wide shot of multiple temples in the complex, each highlighted subtly
panels.action: A wide panorama shows different temples rising from the plain—one crowned by a Shaiva linga, another with Vaishnava emblems, a modest Jain shrine among them, sharing the same horizon.

dialogue.text: Within the same landscape, Hindu and Jain sacred art flourished together. Chandela patrons raised temples to Shiva, Vishnu and the Jinas, in a city where many paths to the divine shared space.

i18n.hi: इसी भूदृश्य में हिंदू और जैन दोनों की पवित्र कला साथ फली। चंदेल आश्रयदाताओं ने शिव, विष्णु और जिनों के मंदिर उठाए, एक ऐसे नगर में जहाँ दिव्य तक कई राहें साथ चलती थीं।

panels.shot: low-angle shot of Devangana standing under the eaves of Kandariya Mahadeva, looking up
panels.action: Under the layered eaves of a great temple, Devangana tilts her head back to study stacked friezes: vyalas, surasundaris, couples and ganas forming rhythmic bands around the tower.

dialogue.text: Standing under Kandariya Mahadeva’s soaring tower, she saw not random decoration but a program. Bands of figures repeated, shifted, answered each other. The stone seemed to follow a grammar.

i18n.hi: कंदरिया महादेव की उड़ती हुई शिखर छाँव में खड़े होकर उसने सजावट नहीं, योजना देखी। पट्टियाँ दोहरती, बदलती, एक–दूसरे को जवाब देती दिखीं। जैसे पत्थर कोई व्याकरण मान रहा हो।

panels.shot: diagrammatic wide shot of a temple elevation, with different horizontal zones subtly distinguished
panels.action: A side view of a temple elevation shows distinct horizontal zones of sculpture: base friezes with animals and processions, middling belts of couples and ladies, upper tiers of deities near the superstructure.

dialogue.text: She mapped the walls. At the base ran processions and animals; in the middle, lively surasundaris and couples; higher, clearer bands of deities. The erotic scenes clustered in particular outer belts.

i18n.hi: उसने दीवारें नक़्शे पर उतारीं। तल के पास जुलूस और जानवर; बीच में चंचल सुरसुंदरियाँ और जोड़े; ऊपर देवताओं की साफ़ पट्टियाँ। कामुक दृश्य कुछ खास बाहरी पट्टों में सिमटे थे।

panels.shot: close-up on Devangana’s face as she makes a note, eyes intent
panels.action: Devangana pauses, pen hovering, a faint spark in her eyes as she writes a short line in her notebook, the word ‘purushartha’ visible on the page.

dialogue.text: In these patterns she sensed an old Indian framework. Dharma. Artha. Kama. Moksha. The four purusharthas—human goals—might be woven into stone, with kama carved as part of a larger path.

i18n.hi: इन पैटर्नों में उसे पुरानी भारतीय रूप–रेखा महसूस हुई। धर्म। अर्थ। काम। मोक्ष। चार पुरुषार्थ—मानव लक्ष्य—शायद पत्थर में बुने हैं, जिसमें काम बस बड़े मार्ग की एक कड़ी है।

panels.shot: triptych-like shot: left shows a judge scene or courtly justice, center shows processions/wealth motifs, right shows an erotic couple, all framed beneath a sanctum
panels.action: Three adjacent panels are suggested in one frame: a king in court, a rich household scene, an embracing couple, all carved below an inner sanctum hinted above in shadow.

dialogue.text: Desai argued: scenes of law and kingship echo dharma, wealth and processions echo artha, erotic maithuna echoes kama. All lie under sanctums pointing toward moksha, release, at the summit.

i18n.hi: देसाई ने तर्क रखा: राज, न्याय और दरबार के दृश्य धर्म की, धन और जुलूस अर्थ की, मैथुन दृश्य काम की गूँज हैं। सबके ऊपर गर्भगृह, जो शिखर पर मोक्ष, मुक्ति की ओर इशारा करता है।

panels.shot: medium shot of her lecturing to a small audience with projected slide of Khajuraho panel behind
panels.action: In a modest lecture hall, Devangana stands beside a projected slide of a Khajuraho wall, gesturing calmly as a few scholars and students watch, some skeptical, some curious.

dialogue.speaker: devangana_desai
dialogue.text: The erotic figures are not manuals. They are one strand in a much wider sacred tapestry.

i18n.hi: ये कामुक आकृतियाँ पाठ्य–पुस्तक नहीं। वे एक बहुत बड़े पवित्र ताने–बाने की बस एक डोरी हैं।

panels.shot: contrasting vignette of 19th–20th century visitors reacting: one embarrassed, one titillated, one dismissive
panels.action: In a vignette montage, an early tourist averts his eyes in embarrassment, another smirks at a guide’s crude joke, a third visitor shrugs, looking only at the erotic band while ignoring nearby deities.

dialogue.text: Before such readings, many outsiders met Khajuraho with giggles or scorn. Colonial and popular imaginations often froze the site into spectacle, ignoring the surrounding gods and rituals.

i18n.hi: ऐसे पढ़ने से पहले, कई बाहरी लोग खजुराहो को हँसी या तिरस्कार से देखते थे। औपनिवेशिक और लोक कल्पनाएँ अक्सर इसे तमाशा बना देतीं, आस–पास के देवताओं और अनुष्ठानों को अनदेखा।

panels.shot: quiet, reverent interior of a Shaiva sanctum with linga, lamp, and priest
panels.action: Inside a dim sanctum, a priest tends a linga with lamp and water, while through the doorway the layered carvings of the exterior walls are just faintly visible in the daylight beyond.

dialogue.text: Yet the heart of these temples remained familiar: Shiva as linga, Vishnu in image, the Jina in meditation. Daily worship and inscriptional praise placed mainstream devotion at the core.

i18n.hi: पर इन मंदिरों का दिल परिचित ही रहा: शिव लिंग रूप में, विष्णु मूर्ति में, जिन ध्यान में। रोज़ की पूजा और शिलालेखों की स्तुति ने मुख्यधारा भक्ति को केंद्र में रखा।

panels.shot: slow push-in on Devangana examining a Jain temple panel with Jina and attendant figures
panels.action: Devangana stands before a Jain temple wall, observing a serene seated Jina flanked by attendant figures, her hand resting lightly on her notebook as she compares notes.

dialogue.text: She followed the trail into Jain temples nearby, noting parallels and differences. The same landscape that hosted Shaiva and Vaishnava imagery also framed the quiet austerity of the Jinas.

i18n.hi: वह पास के जैन मंदिरों तक भी गई, समानताएँ और फर्क नोट किए। यही धरती, जहाँ शिव और विष्णु की छवियाँ थीं, वहीं शांत, संयमी जिन प्रतिमाओं को भी फ्रेम करती थी।

panels.shot: tabletop shot of her two major books side by side, her hand placing a fresh note inside
panels.action: On a wooden table lie two books titled with her works on erotic and religious imagery; Devangana’s hand slips a new handwritten note between the pages, acknowledging an unanswered question.

dialogue.text: In her books, Desai carefully framed her ideas as interpretations, not finally closed answers. No Chandela text survives to explain the scheme; the stone speaks, but in a language we partly guess.

i18n.hi: अपनी पुस्तकों में देसाई ने अपने विचारों को व्याख्या कहा, आख़िरी फैसला नहीं। कोई चंदेल ग्रंथ योजना समझाने को नहीं बचा; पत्थर बोलता है, पर उसकी भाषा हम आधी ही समझते हैं।

panels.shot: UNESCO-style wide shot of restored temples with visitors of diverse backgrounds, guides pointing to various carvings
panels.action: A broad daylight view shows visitors of many ages walking the clean stone paths around restored temples, while a guide gestures first to a deity panel, then to musicians, then to an erotic couple.

dialogue.text: By the late twentieth century, Khajuraho joined the list of World Heritage Sites. New guidebooks and site notes, drawing on such scholarship, began to speak of programs, purusharthas and layered meaning.

i18n.hi: बीसवीं सदी के आख़िर तक खजुराहो विश्व धरोहर सूची में आ जुड़ा। नई गाइडबुक और पट्टिकाएँ, ऐसे शोध पर टिककर, कार्यक्रमों, पुरुषार्थों और तह–दर–तह अर्थों की बात करने लगीं।

panels.shot: evening shot of Devangana sitting on low step facing a temple, sketchbook open on her lap
panels.action: At twilight, Devangana sits on a stone step facing the temple silhouette, sketchbook open, capturing lines of a surasundari while the sky deepens to indigo behind the shikhara.

dialogue.speaker: devangana_desai
dialogue.text: What else is the stone saying that our categories still miss?

i18n.hi: पत्थर और क्या कह रहा है जिसे हमारी मौजूदा खाँचों से पकड़ नहीं पाते?

panels.shot: final wide shot of the temple tower under a starry sky, carvings barely visible as textured shadows
panels.action: Under a clear starry sky, the temple tower rises in silhouette, its carvings now soft shadows, suggesting countless figures still present but quiet in the night.

dialogue.text: Khajuraho’s walls outlasted kings, invaders, neglect and rediscovery. Desai’s work reminds us: before we accept the loudest story, we must walk the stone, count the figures, and listen for the quieter design.

i18n.hi: खजुराहो की दीवारें राजाओं, आक्रमणों, उपेक्षा और पुनःखोज से भी लंबा जी उठीं। देसाई का काम याद दिलाता है: सबसे ज़ोरदार कहानी मानने से पहले, हमें पत्थर पर चलना, आकृतियाँ गिनना और धीमी, सूक्ष्म रचना को सुनना होगा।

subtitle_i18n.en: Devangana Desai and the many meanings of Khajuraho’s stone
subtitle_i18n.hi: देवांगना देसाई और खजुराहो के पत्थरों के कई अर्थ
